query:
SELECT 
  s.id as sale_id,
  s.saleDate,
  s.finalAmount,
  s.status,
  s.saleType,
  p.name as customer_name
FROM sales s
JOIN partners p ON s.customerId = p.id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Victor Hugo%'
ORDER BY s.saleDate DESC
LIMIT 20;
